newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers soft, easing towards bottom.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers soft, easing towards bottom.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes remained soft on Tuesday as cargo prices slipped further and might be reaching a bottom, traders said.
But the current downtrend might be reversed shortly as prices in Singapore have become cheaper compared with other ports, they said.
"Prices here (in Singapore) have fallen to quite an attractive level, that may spark off more buying interest later," a shipowner said.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst prices were quoted around $116 and $122 respectively. MDO and gas oil prices eased to $225-$230 and $245-$248 per tonne respectively.
